notes: Site has 746 properties across 75 pages (Page 1 of 75). Site implements anti-bot protection (403 errors on direct scraper requests), but fetch_page works successfully. May require headless browser (Playwright/Selenium) for production scraping. Pagination uses JavaScript click events on li elements with data-page attributes. Full listing URLs need to be prefixed with base domain. This is a residential real estate site, not business-for-sale listings.
